create.name: Cirak
create.bio:
Cirak is a teacher of presence and awareness who came to spiritual work after more than twenty years as an information architect, planning how people find their way through complex systems for large technology and consumer brands and teaching design thinking at UCLA. In 2015 a stay in the California desert that was meant to last two weeks stretched to six months and began a long period of inner change. He then trained twice through Eckhart Tolle's School of Awakening, later taught on that programme and volunteered alongside Tolle for six years.

His teaching looks at the hidden structure of everyday experience: how an event turns into perception, interpretation, sensation and finally reaction, and how beliefs and identity quietly steer each step. He works through meditation, inquiry, attention to the body and live dialogue rather than theory, returning often to overthinking and emotional reactivity. He leads in-person retreats, including at Kripalu, hosts free live sessions most weeks, sells recorded programmes and virtual retreats filmed in Bali and Greece, and has written several books, among them Be You and The Five Levels of Awareness, with End of Illusion on the way.

books.title: Be You: The Journey of Self-Realization
books.author: Cirak
books.description: His first and most accessible book, written in short chapters for readers new to inner work. It sets out a step-by-step way of noticing reactions, letting them pass and living with more ease.

books.title: The Five Levels of Awareness: A Manual for Inner Peace and Outer Purpose
books.author: Cirak
books.description: A map of five stages that consciousness passes through in ordinary life, with the attitudes and lessons typical of each. Rather than prescribing rules, it helps readers recognise where they are and what the next step might be.

books.title: Old Soul Young Soul: The Path from Seeking to Stillness
books.author: Cirak
books.description: A guide to the idea of soul age and how it colours relationships, purpose and identity. It walks through a hundred common life challenges and how each can be met with more awareness.

courses.title: Direct Experience: A Path to Clarity
courses.description: A five-night residential retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts. Days combine meditation, inquiry, body awareness and quiet reflection, with the aim of living from presence rather than constant mental management.

courses.title: 7-Day Virtual Retreat
courses.description: A complete recorded retreat filmed in Bali, meant to be followed over a clear week at home. Each day holds several sessions of teaching, meditation, movement and sound.

courses.title: Conscious Doing Series
courses.description: An eight-part recorded training in acting from awareness rather than habit. Talks, guided meditations, exercises and journaling prompts look at one area of life per session.

courses.title: InnerPower™ Program
courses.description: A five-week self-guided programme built on five themes: a clearer mind, fuller feeling, higher energy, creative expression and living with intent. Short daily practices help carry each theme into ordinary life.

free_resources.title: 5-Day Awareness Reset
free_resources.description: Five days of recorded morning and evening audio practices made on the coast of Crete, each with a short reflection. Offered free on his site.

free_resources.title: Cirak - Thought Awareness Meditation 12 mins
free_resources.description: A short guided meditation in watching thoughts come and go without following them.

free_resources.title: Cirak - Body Awareness Meditation 51 min
free_resources.description: A long guided practice that moves attention slowly through the body and rests in physical sensation.

free_resources.title: Energy Clearing
free_resources.description: An hour-long guided audio from his resources page, based on his Conscious Release Method of staying present with sensations until they settle.
